title: Fullness and faithfulness of identity inverse image
statement: Fix a six-functor operation datum $S$ of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], including its finite field $k$, coefficient prime $\ell$, finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For each finite-type $k$-space $X$ in its space category, and each of its completed integral, rational and common coefficient stages $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, the supplied identity inverse-image functor $U_X=L\operatorname{id}_X^*:D^b_c(X,\Lambda)\to D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$ is full and faithful: it induces a bijection on every Hom set. There is no assertion about the supplied compositor, projection maps or support functors, and no identity isomorphism is chosen as data.

source.place: First paragraph, identity sentence: the identity adjunctions give the identity mate; proper-case sentence and compactification independence

proof.text: For each finite-type space X, apply lem-pod-isomorphism-field-transport to the scheme identity of X with the fixed coefficient prime and algebraic closure. Use the finite-type and quasi-compact witnesses in X.property. The theorem supplies residue invertibility data and equivalences for the canonical completed integral and rational identity pullbacks at E, and for the canonical common-stage identity pullback. The two supplied invertibility structures on the same scheme agree by subsingleton elimination.

Use the integralPullback, rationalPullback and commonStagePullback normalization fields of the operation datum to rewrite its three supplied identity pullbacks to the canonical functors. An equivalence is full and faithful. Regroup the pointwise conjunction into the three universal assertions. No identity isomorphism is chosen as operation data, and no additional scheme or coefficient hypotheses are imposed.

proof_origin.place: Identity sentence, using the identity specialization of the already-stated isomorphism field transport theorem (lem-pod-isomorphism-field-transport)

theorem projectionIdentity_pullbackUnits (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) :
    (∀ X : SixFunctorSpace D,
      (S.higher.integral.pull (𝟙 X)).Full ∧ (S.higher.integral.pull (𝟙 X)).Faithful) ∧
    (∀ X : SixFunctorSpace D,
      (S.higher.rational.pull (𝟙 X)).Full ∧ (S.higher.rational.pull (𝟙 X)).Faithful) ∧
    (∀ X : SixFunctorSpace D,
      (S.closure.commonStage.pull (𝟙 X)).Full ∧
        (S.closure.commonStage.pull (𝟙 X)).Faithful)
